page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-192-highlssd-metal is a bare-metal, storage-optimized server built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 192 vCPUs across 96 physical Intel Xeon 8481C cores operating at 4.0 GHz with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 1.5 TB of DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the server includes a bundled 77304 GB NVMe SSD array. There are no integrated GPUs.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance across multiple domains. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and PassMark CPU tests ranks in the top 10 percent, aided by advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with both cached small-block and uncached large-block reads and writes placing in the top 10 percent. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also achieve top-tier status. However, single-threaded performance is more moderate, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10 percent.

Given its bare-metal architecture, massive 77.3 TB local NVMe SSD storage, and high memory density, this server provides high resource density for data-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale databases, high-throughput Redis deployments, data warehousing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications. The inclusion of Intel AMX also supports strong performance for CPU-based LLM inference.
